description: This PHP interface defines methods for cryptographic materials providers within the AWS SDK, specifically version 2 of the materials provider interface architecture.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2
classes.description: An interface specifying cryptographic operations for AWS SDK providers, including key size support, wrapping algorithm retrieval, decryption of encryption keys, CEK generation, and IV generation.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a specific key size (in bits) is supported by AES in this provider.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the algorithm used for wrapping keys.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using provider-specific logic, given the encrypted key, material description, and options.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new content encryption key based on provided key size, context, and options.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) based on the specified OpenSSL cipher name.
